articles.title: Dominant outings in crosstown rivalry basketball games between Oshkosh schools
articles.summary: The article details the season's first basketball matchup between crosstown rivals Oshkosh North and Oshkosh West in Oshkosh. Hosted by Oshkosh West, their girls' team secured a victory with a score of 67. This event marked the commencement of the competitive season for both boys' and girls' teams, initiating their local rivalry.

articles.title: 'Of course it's not safe': Small Russian city tries to shrug off war
articles.summary: Authorities in Russia's western regions, including Tver, are regularly implementing prolonged mobile phone service shutdowns. Locals face hours without phone access, a deliberate state measure likely aimed at national security. This widespread communication disruption points to tactical responses against potential external threats or information control efforts, significantly impacting daily life for citizens in these areas and highlighting the intersection of technology and defence strategy.
